services.desc: Come up to Bayside for the weekend or camp Sunshine Coast style for a week or longer! Bayside Campground is less than 5 minutes from Sechelt Village, and 2 minutes from Porpoise Bay Provincial Park. Enjoy our smaller site with less people... head to the beach, hiking trails, Coast Gravity Park, or paddle in Sechelt Inlet during the day, and return to your quiet & treed site for your evening campfire. “We had a great time at this campground. blurb: Only 90 minutes by ferry from West Vancouver and a 30 minute drive from the Langdale Ferry Terminal to Sechelt Inlet, Bayside Campground & RV Park is your home away from home for an overnight stay, weekend getaway, or even a week or longer! We are open year-round, and offer 16 private tenting sites, 10 partial hookup sites, and 20 RV full hookup sites (including drive-through sites for your convenience).
